title: Simple Right-Click Harvest
description: Harvest and replant your crops instantly with a simple right-click!
body:
# Simple Right-Click Harvest 🌱

Make your Minecraft farming experience realistic, balanced, and effortless! This lightweight Quality of Life (QoL) mod allows you to harvest and replant crops quickly, but with a balanced twist to fit perfectly into vanilla gameplay.

## ✨ Key Features
* **Hoe Requirement:** To keep the game balanced, you must be holding a **Hoe** (any tier) in your hand to use the right-click harvest feature.
* **Smart Harvesting:** The mod only works on **fully grown (100%)** crops. Say goodbye to accidentally breaking unripe plants!
* **Instant Auto-Replant:** Automatically replants the crop on the exact same spot by consuming a seed directly from your inventory.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Fits seamlessly into survival mode and large modpacks without feeling like a cheat.

## ⚙️ Requirements
* **Mod Loader:** Fabric
* **Dependencies:** Fabric API

## 🎮 Compatibility
Fully compatible with Minecraft **fabric** and works beautifully on both single-player worlds and multiplayer servers (Required on both Client and Server).
